title: NPER numeric: 1286 of 1286 bit-exact on the production-kernel replay
upstream_status_verbatim: identified and signed off `1286/1286` + `7/7` error rows (catalogue reconcile 2026-07-11; the G6-08 row was removed)
status_plain: The production NPER kernel was replayed over every deduplicated answered witness and matched Excel's bits on 1,286 of 1,286 numeric rows. This is the NUMERIC count only. The same sentence publishes a second figure, 7 of 7 error rows, which is typed-error matching and belongs on the structural axis; it is recorded separately in EV-FIN-0007. The two must never be added. Their sum appears in no OxFunc source, and any merged numerator on the numeric axis is fabricated. Held-out status is partial: the corpus is "every deduplicated answered witness", which is the union of the discovery probes the identification was searched on with the held-out sweep, and the source never publishes how many of the 1,286 were held out, so the row split cannot be filled.
